investigation_title: InspectAI Phase 15: External Validation Failure Analysis
scope: Comprehensive audit of Phase 14 Paderborn zero-shot evaluation (8.29% accuracy)

window_count_reconciliation.root_cause: 11 recordings exceed nominal duration (4.01s to 4.02s, >256,000 samples), yielding 91 windows instead of 90.

sensor_channel.status: VALID: Both record single-axis drive-end radial vibration.

physical_units.status: VALID: Preprocessor applies exact physical conversion (m/s^2 -> g).

sampling_rate_and_decimation.cwru: 12,000 Hz native (faults) or 48,000 -> 12,000 Hz polyphase decimation (normal)
sampling_rate_and_decimation.status: VALID: Anti-aliased polyphase resampling matches target fs = 12,000 Hz.

dc_offset_and_filtering.cwru: Mean subtraction + 4th order zero-phase Butterworth bandpass (20-5000 Hz)
dc_offset_and_filtering.paderborn: Mean subtraction + 4th order zero-phase Butterworth bandpass (20-5000 Hz)
dc_offset_and_filtering.status: VALID: Identical filter type, order, cutoffs, and zero-phase implementation.

window_segmentation.status: VALID: Identical window length (2048 samples = 170.67 ms) and stride.

hilbert_envelope_spectrum.cwru: compute_hilbert_envelope_spectrum -> zero-mean detrending -> one-sided rfft -> 1025 bins
hilbert_envelope_spectrum.paderborn: compute_hilbert_envelope_spectrum -> zero-mean detrending -> one-sided rfft -> 1025 bins
hilbert_envelope_spectrum.status: VALID: Identical function, identical 1025 frequency bins (0 to 6000 Hz).

normalization.paderborn: Evaluated using exact frozen CWRU normalizers
normalization.status: VALID: Zero data leakage; frozen statistics applied consistently.

input_tensor_contract.status: VALID: Output dimensions, channel ordering, and float32 dtype match exactly.

section_2_pipeline_audit.conclusion: The failure is NOT due to an implementation bug, shape mismatch, or unit error. The preprocessing implementation is mathematically and structurally identical.

section_3_model_activation_audit.finding: On Paderborn signals, the logits for Class 1 (Ball Fault) and Class 3 (Outer Race) consistently dominate. For healthy K001, mean logits are [-3.18, +2.86, -2.44, +0.12], producing an 89.2% softmax probability for Ball Fault. The classifier never activates the Normal or Inner Race heads because Paderborn envelope spectra lack CWRU-specific carrier harmonics.

section_4_kinematic_spectral_audit.scientific_assessment: The physical defect impact frequencies differ by 31.0 Hz (BPFO), 38.5 Hz (BPFI), and 91.4 Hz (BSF). Because the 1D CNN spectral branch uses fixed-frequency convolutional filters trained on CWRU's frequency bins, Paderborn defect harmonics do not trigger the intended convolutional filters, confirming frequency-domain feature misalignment.

category_a_confirmed_implementation_bugs: Zero code bugs, shape mismatches, or pipeline calculation errors were detected.
Window count variation (7,211 vs 7,200 nominal) is confirmed to be caused by physical acquisition duration differences (4.00s to 4.02s) across Paderborn DAQ recordings, not a software defect.
category_b_likely_physical_and_architect: Kinematic defect frequency mismatch: 6203 bearings at 1500 RPM produce BPFO=76.3 Hz and BPFI=123.7 Hz, differing by 31 Hz and 38.5 Hz from CWRU's 107.4 Hz and 162.2 Hz. Fixed-frequency 1D CNN spectral filters fail to capture out-of-bin harmonics.

Absolute amplitude shift: Paderborn signals exhibit 3-12x lower vibration amplitude (RMS 0.018 - 0.050 g) than CWRU (RMS 0.058 - 0.450 g). The healthy Paderborn bearing has lower RMS than CWRU healthy, but higher crest factor and high-frequency content, mimicking micro-impact ball faults.
Rig structural resonance and sensor transfer function: CWRU uses motor housing accelerometers; Paderborn uses an external bearing test module with distinct damping and acoustic properties.
category_c_unresolved_hypotheses_and_ope: Whether order-tracking (angular domain resampling) alone is sufficient to enable cross-dataset zero-shot transfer, or if domain adaptation (e.g. CORAL / adversarial feature alignment) is strictly required.
Whether unsupervised test-time normalization (e.g. adaptive batch normalization) can bridge the amplitude and variance shift without ground-truth labels.

recommended_next_step: Phase 16: Order-Tracking Angular Domain Formulation and Domain Adaptation Exploration.
